原文:
This is a good choice for a mid range (50-70$) earbuds that comes with a few excellent features and some drawbacks that will make you love your airpods or buds even more.

The main positives - the BT connectivity is excellent and zero loss of signal while jogging/yard work etc. Never had to repair the earbuds to my phone (Note). Battery life is as advertised and very pleasing. Fit is comfortable and no heaviness or blocked feeling.

The could-be-better - getting used to the stem controls is not that easy and has been finicky at times. Volume/bass is mediocre at best. Though some noise reduction is perceivable, it is uneven. It is IPX5 rated, means it should be able to "resist a sustained, low-pressure water jet spray".

At the advertised price, you are paying really for the battery life, BT chip, above-average noise suppression and average sound. Overall, a decent pair for using in situations where you are OK sacrificing performance (travel, yard work, jogging etc - where one could lose or step on it ).
中文翻译: 对于中档（50-70美元）的耳塞来说，这是一个不错的选择，它带有一些出色的功能和一些缺点，这些缺点会让你更加喜爱你的AirPods或Buds。主要的优点——蓝牙连接非常出色，在慢跑/庭院工作等时信号零丢失。从未需要将耳塞重新配对到我的手机（Note）。电池寿命如广告所说，非常令人满意。佩戴舒适，没有沉重感或堵塞感。可以更好的地方——适应柄式控制并不容易，有时很挑剔。音量/低音充其量只是平庸。虽然可以感知到一些降噪，但不均匀。它具有IPX5等级，意味着它应该能够“抵抗持续的低压水喷射”。在广告价格下，你真正支付的是电池寿命、蓝牙芯片、高于平均的噪声抑制和平均的音质。总体而言，对于在你可以接受牺牲性能的情况下使用（旅行、庭院工作、慢跑等——可能会丢失或踩到的地方），这是一副不错的耳塞。

原文: Such cute packaging and such professional feeling ear buds. Unfortunately the sound is AWFUL. They sound like listening to a cassette tape on a Walkman with those small foam headphones....from 3 feet away. Seriously, I couldn’t believe hoe poor the sound quality was. No bass. No clear treble. If the packaging and feel wasn’t so good I would give them 1 star. But I bumped it to 2 for appearances Only.  If they could fix the sound, they would have a winner!
中文翻译: 如此可爱的包装和如此专业感觉的耳塞。不幸的是，声音糟透了。它们听起来就像用随身听上的小泡沫耳机听磁带……从3英尺远的地方。说真的，我简直不敢相信音质这么差。没有低音。没有清晰的高音。如果包装和手感不是那么好，我会给它们1星。但我仅为了外观把它提到了2星。如果它们能修复声音，它们会是一个赢家！

原文: Sound quality is no where near the less sleek (but way less expensive) Otium I have.  Lose connection in one bud or another randomly, and wind up skipping songs, etc, due to movement.  Mediocre at best.
中文翻译: 音质远不及我拥有的那款不那么时尚（但便宜得多）的Otium。随机地一只或另一只耳塞会断连，还会因为移动而跳过歌曲等等。充其量只能算平庸。

原文: These are easily the best sounding Bluetooth earbuds that I have ever tried. Bass sounds natural without being artificially boosted like in some earbuds. Excellent clarity in the mid and upper frequencies. Acousting music and vocals sound really great. Overall volume can be louder than I ever want. 8 hour playing time puts those Apple earbuds to shame. A couple of minor complaints: I don't like devices that still use the outdated micro-USB connectors, especially now that USB-C is becoming widespread. At least they do include a cable. Also, the buttons are a little confusing with the big central button controlling on/off, play/pause, and phone answer/call/redial. I don't make many phone calls through my earbuds, but if you do, the controls may be a problem for you.
中文翻译: 这些无疑是我试过音质最好的蓝牙耳机。低音听起来很自然，不像某些耳机那样被人为增强。中高频的清晰度极佳。原声音乐和人声听起来真的很棒。整体音量可以比我想要的更响。8小时的播放时间让那些苹果耳机相形见绌。有几个小问题：我不喜欢仍然使用过时的micro-USB接口的设备，尤其是现在USB-C正在普及。至少它们确实附带了一根线。另外，按钮有点令人困惑，大的中央按钮控制开关、播放/暂停以及电话接听/通话/重拨。我不怎么通过耳机打电话，但如果你经常打，控制可能会成为你的问题。

原文:
These have great sound & the one ear functionality is great. I also like the fact that I can push the little toggle button if a call comes in & it will pause my music while I take the call. They are also useful for just talking on the phone.

BUT. This siliconized material grabs EVERYTHING & constantly yanks the dang thing out of my ear. That makes it really hard to use. So, despite the positives, I can only give it two stars.
中文翻译:
这些耳机音质很棒，单耳功能也很出色。我还喜欢这一点：如果有电话打进来，我可以按下那个小切换按钮，它会在接电话时暂停我的音乐。它们对于单纯打电话也很有用。

但是。这种硅胶化材质会粘住一切东西，还不断把这玩意儿从我耳朵里拽出来。这让它很难使用。所以，尽管有这些优点，我只能给它两颗星。

原文: I’m a trucker and my radio in my truck does not have Bluetooth, but it does have an auxiliary jack - which is needed to use this. Pairing was very easy and pairs automatically after setup. Sound quality I think is quite good. I stream Sirius from my phone. Battery seems to last 4 - 5 . It comes with a cig lighter type plug to charge it, but I don’t use it and directly plug in the charging cable to the transmitter so I can leave it in the radio jack. I’m very pleased with this unit.
中文翻译: 我是卡车司机，我卡车里的收音机没有蓝牙，但它有一个辅助插孔——使用这个设备需要这个插孔。配对非常简单，设置后会自动配对。我觉得音质相当不错。我从手机流媒体播放Sirius。电池似乎能用4到5小时。它配有一个点烟器式插头来充电，但我不用它，而是直接把充电线插到发射器上，这样我就可以把它留在收音机插孔里。我对这个设备非常满意。

原文: Well made,beutifull wood, nice cables...but the sound is mediocre for me.The bass is week.My Skulcandy wich cost 20$ at BestBuy are way better regarding performance.

原文: My daughter is attending virtual schooling which requires listening to classes online and completing studies online.  These work great.  She wears them almost every day at the computer and they fit her perfectly (she's 10) so they can be adjusted down to fit a child's head. She has claimed them as hers so I haven't been able to use them myself.  I also like the fact that they microphone arm is rigid without the foam covered mic at the end.  I have a headphone/mic that came with the Rosetta Stone program that is bendable with the mic with foam cover.  It seems I could never get the mic far away from my mouth...to the point where it seemed it was pressing against my lips.  Needless to say, that is aggravating.  This headset also has a volume control on the headphones which is a nice extra.  The mic also can turn either way if you would prefer having it on the left side or right.  All in all I think they are pretty nice headphones and work perfect for online schooling.
中文翻译: 我的女儿正在参加虚拟学校课程，需要在线听课和完成在线学习。这些耳机非常好用。她几乎每天都在电脑前戴着它们，而且它们非常适合她（她10岁），所以可以调小以适应孩子的头型。她已经把它们占为己有，所以我一直没能自己用。我还喜欢麦克风臂是刚性的，末端没有泡沫覆盖的麦克风。我有一套随Rosetta Stone程序附带的耳机/麦克风，那是可弯曲的，麦克风带有泡沫罩。似乎我永远无法让麦克风远离我的嘴……以至于它似乎压在我的嘴唇上。不用说，那很烦人。这款耳机还在耳机上设有音量控制，这是一个不错的额外功能。麦克风也可以转向任意一侧，如果你更喜欢把它放在左侧或右侧。总的来说，我认为它们是非常好的耳机，非常适合在线学习。

原文: You really cannot beat the price on these. However, the sound is heavily compressed, and the wires are cheap. Nevertheless, I live in a house with a kitten and have a teenager who loses things. 原文: I have small ears, so earbuds simply do not stay in.  Even the ones with the ear loops fall out.  So I've always used over-the-ear headphones.  The big ones are too clunky.  These are just right!  The head band can be bent so as to achieve the right pressure, and the bluetooth aspect makes it so easy to wear when I am out and about and not having to worry about a cord getting in my way.  Others have mentioned that finding and using the charging port is a bit wonky, and it's true.  Sound quality is not concert-hall, by any means, but respectable enough.  I actually like that it's not noise-canceling, as I walk in the city and like to know what's coming up on me.  I do wish there was a volume control on the headphones, instead of having to control it on my device, but it's a small bother.  I would absolutely buy again if these ever die on me.
中文翻译: 我的耳朵很小，所以耳塞根本戴不住。即使带耳挂的也会掉出来。所以我一直用头戴式耳机。大的那种太笨重了。这款刚刚好！头带可以弯曲，以达到合适的压力，蓝牙功能让我在外出时佩戴非常方便，不用担心线缆碍事。其他人提到找到和使用充电口有点别扭，确实如此。音质绝不是音乐厅级别的，但足够体面。我其实喜欢它不降噪，因为我在城市里走路，喜欢知道周围有什么靠近我。我希望耳机上有音量控制，而不是必须在设备上控制，但这是个小麻烦。如果这副耳机坏了，我绝对会再买。

原文: I originally purchased the antenna because of the reviews and they're pretty much spot on. I plugged it in and ran a channel scan and got 75 channels. Amazing!  Truly an amazing little black box.
中文翻译: 我最初是因为评论才购买这款天线的，而评论基本上都很准确。我插上电源，运行了频道扫描，收到了75个频道。太棒了！真是一个令人惊叹的小黑盒子。

原文:
I purchased these to replace the Mpow Flame light that I had lost one of the earbuds too. I have gone through a couple of these.

What I do like is the charging case. It is pretty slim, it is USB C, and it also has a display to show how much of a charge it has. This is super helpful. It also has volume and connect/disconnect buttons. This has not yet had any charging issues, but I have not owned it for very long.

Now for what I don't like- They do not fit my ear that well. It may be the shape of hook, the length of the arm from which the speaker is mounted, or some other variable. The hook keeps it in place, but it never feels as if it's in my ear properly. I also think the sound is not so hot, and for 50 dollars I was expecting more. It is a little treble heavy on the heavier frequencies and just sounds like a cheap driver.

My previous headphone was the MPow Flame Lite. The charging case is bulkier and bare and there is no digital display. With that said- these are now 1/3 of the price. What I do like is that they fit my ear like a glove, and the sound quality is phenominal. It sounds like a much bigger driver. I am not an audiophile, but it really sounds great. Maybe it is the mid that come in fuller giving it a rich sound.

I have had some charging issues. Sometimes I find that only one of the headphones are dead and the other is fully charged. However, fit and sound are my most important details so these are my favorite. For the price I can purchase three and keep them in different places. If I lose one or have a charging issue I can replace it with the extra. This makes much more sense than keeping the aI do not more.

Edit: I changed from 3 to 5 stars. I have owned these now for almost one year, and use them probably every day. There has been no decrease in performance or battery life. I was so accustomed to my previous ear buds that I did not like these much at first. However, the sound is balanced, the battery life is great, and I really like the charging case. I have never actually times the batter life, but it is probably about 7-8 hours on a full charge. There are sooo many choices now for bluetooth ear buds, but these are a safe bet and most people should be happy. I am however not an audiophile, and someone who truly is may want to spend more on a Bose, or whatever the best ear buds are nowadays. My previous ones were more bass heavy, but these are better balanced. They do stay in the ear, unless I go to lay down on my back; I then have to push them back into my ear.
中文翻译:
我买这些是为了替换我丢失了一只耳塞的Mpow Flame light。我已经用坏了几副这样的耳机。

我喜欢的是充电盒。它相当薄，是USB-C接口，还有一个显示屏显示电量。这非常有用。它还有音量和连接/断开按钮。目前还没有出现充电问题，但我拥有它的时间还不长。

现在说说我不喜欢的——它们不太贴合我的耳朵。可能是挂钩的形状、扬声器臂的长度，或者其他什么变量。挂钩能把它固定住，但总感觉没有正确地戴在耳朵里。我还觉得音质不怎么样，对于50美元的价格，我期望更高。它在较重频率上有点偏高频，听起来就像廉价的驱动单元。

我之前的耳机是MPow Flame Lite。充电盒更笨重、更简陋，没有数字显示屏。话虽如此——这些现在只要三分之一的价格。我喜欢的是它像手套一样贴合我的耳朵，音质非常出色。听起来像大得多的驱动单元。我不是发烧友，但听起来真的很棒。也许是中频更饱满，赋予了它丰富的声音。

我遇到过一些充电问题。有时我发现只有一只耳机没电，另一只充满电。然而，贴合度和音质是我最看重的细节，所以这些是我最喜欢的。就价格而言，我可以买三副，放在不同的地方。如果我丢了一只或有充电问题，我可以用备用的替换。这比保留我不再用的那副合理多了。

编辑：我从3星改成了5星。我现在已经拥有这些将近一年了，几乎每天都用。性能或电池寿命没有下降。我太习惯之前的耳塞了，所以一开始不太喜欢这些。然而，声音是平衡的，电池寿命很棒，我真的很喜欢充电盒。我从未实际计时过电池寿命，但充满电大概能用7-8小时。现在蓝牙耳塞有太多选择了，但这些是稳妥的选择，大多数人应该会满意。不过我不是发烧友，真正发烧的人可能愿意花更多钱买Bose，或者现在最好的耳塞。我之前的更重低音，但这些更平衡。它们确实能留在耳朵里，除非我躺下；那时我就得把它们推回耳朵里。

原文: I own multiple pairs of wireless earbuds. Apple pro, Samsung buds+ and these.  I wear a headphone nearly 24/7. I sleep with them in to cancel out my partners snoring and to listen to something while I do everything. I decided to return the Sony pair. Unlike the other two, these were the largest devices. Even though I could fit them to my ear, after an hour they would be drooping and falling out. I could never get them to stay in my ears. There is nothing to keep them inside my ear and they are not balanced weight wise. The sound was comparable to the AirPod pros. Because they droop, they would initially do great canceling out noise, but would fail as they fell out. Overall I thought they were just ok in comparison to the Samsung for fit and apple for sound quality. The case does not have wireless charging unlike the other two. The Bluetooth connection was less reliable in comparison. It frequently disconnected when worn throughout the day and dropped the connection at a shorter distance. Disappointed.
中文翻译: 我拥有多副无线耳塞。Apple Pro、Samsung Buds+ 以及这副。我几乎全天候佩戴耳机。我戴着它们睡觉以抵消伴侣的鼾声，并在做任何事情时听点东西。我决定退回这副 Sony。与其他两副不同，这副是最大的设备。尽管我能把它们塞进耳朵，但一小时后它们就会下垂并掉出来。我始终无法让它们留在耳朵里。没有任何东西能让它们保持在耳内，而且重量不平衡。音质与 AirPod Pro 相当。由于下垂，它们最初降噪效果很好，但掉出后就失效了。总体而言，与 Samsung 的贴合度和 Apple 的音质相比，我认为它们只是还行。充电盒没有无线充电，不像其他两副。蓝牙连接相比之下不太可靠。全天佩戴时经常断开，并且在较短距离内就掉线。失望。

原文: Crappy sound quality, poor fit, volume control doesn't work. Low quality item.
中文翻译: 音质很差，佩戴不合适，音量控制不起作用。低质量的产品。

原文: A lot disappointed. The sound comming out of these headphones is very clear and precise however, they don't crank up as I'd like. When I want to listen to music I want to be able to turn the sound down, I have my Galaxy grand prime at max audio and it doesn't matter what I do to these headphones, the sound remains the same. They still sound like 50% audio. I turn the volume knob up or down, zero difference.
中文翻译: 有点失望。这些耳机发出的声音非常清晰和精确，但是它们不能像我希望的那样把音量调大。当我想听音乐时，我希望能把声音调小，我的 Galaxy Grand Prime 已经调到最大音量，而无论我对这些耳机做什么，声音都保持不变。它们听起来仍然像 50% 的音量。我把音量旋钮调高或调低，零差别。

原文:
The Wireless Earbuds arrived as described nicely packaged. Once opened I inspected all items and found no physical defects. The ear buds came charged so I went right into testing.

Connecting to my iPhone was easy and took seconds. During the week of testing i worn around the house, yard, out driving and on runs. I experienced issues with connectivity were sound would drop out but come back immediately and spacial issues were the sound was not synced between the the left and right earbuds. Both issues were intermittent but frequent enough to be a problem and happen at random. One earbud use I only experienced the sound drop outs.

Sound quality is good, they are no AirPod pros or Bose but for the price I had no issues with sound quality.

The tap features I could not get to work but on occasion no matter what I tried. This was irritating.

The earbuds and case appear well made. I would say quality of both are average. Charging was simple and quick. The LED is a nice addition.

They were comfortable to wear and stayed in my ears well while running and doing other activities. There are three different sized ear cups to choose from.

Overall, I give the item 2 stars. This is due to the core features having issues and not functioning as designed.
中文翻译:
无线耳塞按描述到达，包装精美。打开后我检查了所有物品，没有发现物理缺陷。耳塞已充电，所以我直接开始测试。

连接我的iPhone很容易，只需几秒钟。在测试的一周里，我在家里、院子里、开车和跑步时都戴着。我遇到了连接问题，声音会中断但立即恢复，还有空间问题，即左右耳塞之间的声音不同步。这两个问题都是间歇性的，但频繁到足以成为问题，并且随机发生。单耳使用时，我只遇到了声音中断。

音质不错，它们不是AirPod Pro或Bose，但就价格而言，我对音质没有问题。

点击功能我无法使其工作，但偶尔无论我尝试什么。这很烦人。

耳塞和充电盒看起来做工精良。我会说两者的质量都是平均的。充电简单快捷。LED是一个不错的附加功能。

它们佩戴舒适，在跑步和其他活动时能很好地留在耳朵里。有三种不同尺寸的耳塞可供选择。

总体而言，我给这个物品2星。这是因为核心功能有问题，没有按设计运行。

原文: I definitely prefer to use Bluetooth earbuds any day over wired, but sometimes it can't be helped.  Such as times when my Bluetooth earbuds weren't charged.  The sound of these is o.k. but not what you'd be getting from a high end pair.  I teach classical guitar so my acid test for any earbud is playing that and seeing how it sounds.  I'm doing it now and the trebles come through o.k. but the bass is pretty weak.  These will be good to keep a pair in my car or purse for those times when my Bluetooths won't work for whatever reasons.  The volume doesn't work so it has to be adjusted on the device they're plugged into.  They come with extra earbud covers and they feel fine in my female ears the way they are.  I don't know what these cost as of this review but I wouldn't want to pay more than $15.00 for them.

原文:
3-day update: After trying many tips I'm still not overly impressed. I found I got the best fit with the wire over rear but the mic keeps them from being practical over-ear and the angle of the wire on the other side with the tip at the best angle for kept making the wire come off my ear. In not a fan of comply tips but I finally tried them as a last resort and the sound did improve. But in the end, my theory is that I just can't get these deep enough in my ear due to the large housing to get some bass to balance out the brightness. But even if it did I find the mid-range to lack warmth and certain aspect of the sound to be harsh.

First impression - not as impressed as some

Disclaimer: Everyone's ear is different, and tips make a big difference. Because of my ears, I have to use big tips and a shallow fit. Those who can get a deeper fit my hear something completely different. Also, I'm being really picky to help others decide if this is the right phones for them.

I wanted to try these on my computer because that is where all my music is stored that I've used for decades to audition audio gear. So this will be based on Pandora on my phone at 192kb. This is fine because this is how I will be listening to them.

I could not get a comfortable fit with the included tips. The largest tips were not large enough for my ears. So I dug through my collection and found a good fit. Pairing went fine.

They feel a little heavy to me but maybe that is the price of Bluetooth and the magnets? This is my first pair of Bluetooth in-ears. Build quality seem good for the price (I got them on sale) and I'd say the build quality is about average for their normal selling price. While they look like they have good strain relief it's actually very stiff plastic creating a 'hard point' where the wires come out. I like the little magnet for when I want to take them out but not take them off. It's one of the reasons I got these. If you run, I'd worry a little bit about the weight they add.

The sound. I like tight bass, well controlled, no extra bloom/extension But these are bass shy to my ears. For a workout, I like a fun sound and these ain't that. They are a bit bright and brassy at times I noticed the most on 70s classic rock. They lack a richness in the mids that I noticed most with male vocals. Turning them up did not improve they sound, as they got louder they became painful bright/brassy and bass did not improve. They went loud enough to distort the drivers so volume should not be an issue for anyone.

They do a pretty good job of revealing detail and room acoustics are rendered decently and there is some space around the instruments but not much of a soundstage.

While not sterile they lack some musicality that I'd prefer. Did I mention that male voice sound thin. They lack a fullness and resonance for the male voice. I notice this lack of 'something' on drums as well which are buried in the mix. It seems like the SQ is geared to making them sound impressive and accurate and while they succeed in that to some extent it's at the expense of other parts of the sound. I can see getting some fatigue after a while if you listen for more than an hour or so. Sibilance is not an issue. You hear the sibilance on some songs because it's there but it's not going to wear you out.

I can see why some people would like these especially if you are coming from lower quality mushy sounding earphones. If you are used to better earphones and looking for some less expensive earphones for working out you may like these if you like a 'clear' sound but the word that keeps coming to mind as I listen to them more and more is 'thin'. Not thin/thin but a lack of richness and resonance. If you want some bass especially some extension/bloom (again wearing/tips can make a difference) and a bit of 'drive' I'd consider a different set.
中文翻译:
3天更新：尝试了许多技巧后，我仍然没有特别印象深刻。我发现将线材绕在耳后能获得最佳佩戴，但麦克风使它们无法作为实用的耳挂式耳机，而另一侧线材的角度与耳塞最佳角度配合时，线材总是从我的耳朵上滑落。我不喜欢Comply耳塞，但最后作为最后的手段尝试了它们，声音确实有所改善。但最终，我的理论是，由于外壳较大，我无法将它们足够深地插入耳朵以获得一些低音来平衡亮度。但即使如此，我发现中频缺乏温暖感，声音的某些方面显得刺耳。

第一印象——没有像一些人那样印象深刻

免责声明：每个人的耳朵都不同，耳塞有很大影响。由于我的耳朵，我必须使用大耳塞和浅佩戴。那些能获得更深佩戴的人可能会听到完全不同的声音。另外，我真的很挑剔，以帮助其他人决定这是否是适合他们的耳机。

我想在我的电脑上尝试这些，因为那里存储了我几十年来用于试听音频设备的所有音乐。所以这将基于我手机上192kb的Pandora。这没问题，因为这就是我将要听它们的方式。

我无法用随附的耳塞获得舒适的佩戴。最大的耳塞对我的耳朵来说不够大。所以我翻遍了我的收藏，找到了合适的。配对进行得很顺利。

它们对我来说感觉有点重，但也许这是蓝牙和磁铁的代价？这是我第一对蓝牙入耳式耳机。对于价格来说，做工质量似乎不错（我是在促销时买的），我会说做工质量对于它们的正常售价来说大约是平均水平。虽然它们看起来有很好的应力消除，但实际上是僵硬的塑料，在电线出来的地方形成了一个“硬点”。我喜欢那个小磁铁，当我想取下它们但不想完全摘下时。这是我买这些的原因之一。如果你跑步，我会有点担心它们增加的重量。

声音。我喜欢紧实的低音，控制良好，没有额外的膨胀/延伸。但在我听来，这些低音不足。对于锻炼，我喜欢有趣的声音，而这些不是那样。它们有时有点明亮和刺耳，我在70年代经典摇滚中注意到最多。它们在中频缺乏丰富度，我在男声中注意到最多。调大音量并没有改善它们的声音，随着音量变大，它们变得痛苦地明亮/刺耳，低音也没有改善。它们可以大声到使驱动器失真，所以音量对任何人来说都不应该是个问题。

它们在揭示细节方面做得相当不错，房间声学渲染得不错，乐器周围有一些空间，但声场不大。

虽然不是毫无生气，但它们缺乏我更喜欢的一些音乐性。我提到过男声听起来单薄吗？它们缺乏男声的饱满度和共鸣。我在鼓上也注意到了这种缺乏‘某种东西’，鼓声被埋没了。

原文:
In full disclosure, I must admit that I miss my Bose Bluetooth speaker. Their acoustics are impeccable. The "Tribit XSound Go Bluetooth Speakers" only cost a fraction of my Bose speaker. I first purchased the "DOSS Touch Wireless Bluetooth" which is in the same price range; I returned that product because it lacked bass and was unimpressive overall. The Tribit, however, has plenty of bass for such a small speaker. Ironically, the problem that I have is the treble! I think it is an inherent problem with smaller speakers and not this particular device. I have installed an equalizer on my computer which mitigates some of the problems and makes the speaker sound very acceptable.

The pros:
• The speaker is loud! It is perfect for a jam session in your bedroom. I'm not sure it is suitable for large or multi rooms.
• The quality is good, and the speaker looks like a million bucks.
• It has an excellent microphone that works well with phone calls and even to interact with Siri or Cortana.
• The Play button allows one to answer, reject or end a call. It also can play or pause a song. Finally, it allows you to skip a music track forward or backward.

The cons:
• While the bass is fairly impressive, the treble is slightly overriding.
• The battery does not nearly last for 24 hours if you like to blast music as I do
• The speaker can only be paired to one device at a time. If you are listening to music on the computer and the phone tries to connect, the speaker will sometimes disconnect from all devices. The speaker does have an av input one could connect to the computer but obviously, the speaker would no longer be completely portable. This could be a deal breaker for many.

After comparing this speaker with others in its price range, I realize that this speaker has such poor sound quality that I could never recommend it to anyone.
中文翻译: 完全披露，我必须承认我怀念我的Bose蓝牙音箱。它们的音质无可挑剔。而“Tribit XSound Go蓝牙音箱”的价格只是我的Bose音箱的一小部分。我最初购买了“DOSS Touch无线蓝牙音箱”，价格范围相同；我退回了那个产品，因为它缺乏低音，整体上不令人印象深刻。然而，Tribit对于这么小的音箱来说有足够的低音。讽刺的是，我的问题是高音！我认为这是较小音箱的固有问题，而不是这个特定设备的问题。我在电脑上安装了一个均衡器，这减轻了一些问题，使音箱的声音非常可接受。

原文:
I will start by saying that I am typically not a fan of ear buds. I will also say that the very best headphones I have is a set of Sony active noise canceling ear buds. I have always had good success with Sony audio products and I regard the brand as an upper mid-range line. These buds are disappointing in that, while they’re comfortable for ear buds, the sound profile is lacking, specifically in the midrange.

This is a basic set of ear buds that work as you might expect. They do not have ANC functionality, there is no battery or battery pack and there is no Bluetooth functionality. These are straight plug-in audio gear with no fancy features. These will work with just about any device that provides a 3.5mm audio jack.

Most ear buds are uncomfortable to me, but these are surprisingly comfortable and I can wear these for a good bit of time. They come with several inserts of varying sizes so you can find the size that fits your ear canal just right. The included inserts are soft and do not irritate my ears as much as others have done in the past. I still very much prefer over-the-ear headphones which is a personal preference more than anything.

So, where’s the problem? The problem lies in the sound profile which is unbalanced. Having used literally dozens of sets of ear buds and headphones over the past 3-5 years I have developed a good feel for what sounds right and what doesn’t. Most ear buds have one of two issues, either way too much bass or almost none at all. These are surprising in that they actually get the bass just about right, not too heavy and not too light. The highs are very bright and clear, perhaps a touch too piercing for my tastes but not to the point of being unacceptable. The midrange, though, is flat. The result is that music sounds somewhat sterile and lackluster. This is similar to the issue I have seen with my Bose headset. These still sound good, but they fall short of where they could and should be.

Normally I would rate ear buds with a glitch in the sound profile a little higher, as they’re still quite usable and they sound decent. But, these are much more expensive than the average and I have heard less expensive buds with more balanced sound. Sony makes a number of sets of ear buds and headphones, but these are not among their best offerings.
中文翻译:
我首先要说，我通常不喜欢入耳式耳机。我还要说，我拥有的最好的耳机是一套索尼主动降噪入耳式耳机。我一直对索尼音频产品有很好的体验，我认为这个品牌属于中高端产品线。这些耳机令人失望，因为虽然作为入耳式耳机它们很舒适，但声音轮廓有所欠缺，特别是在中频方面。

这是一套基本的入耳式耳机，功能如你所料。它们没有ANC功能，没有电池或电池组，也没有蓝牙功能。这些是直接插入的音频设备，没有花哨的功能。它们几乎可以与任何提供3.5毫米音频插孔的设备配合使用。

大多数入耳式耳机对我来说都不舒服，但这些出奇地舒适，我可以长时间佩戴。它们配有几种不同尺寸的耳塞，因此你可以找到刚好适合你耳道的尺寸。随附的耳塞很柔软，不像过去其他耳塞那样刺激我的耳朵。我仍然更喜欢头戴式耳机，这更多是个人偏好。

那么，问题在哪里？问题在于声音轮廓不平衡。在过去3-5年里，我使用了数十套入耳式耳机和头戴式耳机，我对什么听起来正确、什么不正确有了很好的感觉。大多数入耳式耳机有两个问题之一，要么低音太多，要么几乎没有。这些耳机令人惊讶的是，它们的低音实际上恰到好处，不太重也不太轻。高音非常明亮清晰，也许对我来说有点太刺耳，但还没有到不可接受的程度。然而，中频是平淡的。结果是音乐听起来有些单调乏味。这类似于我在Bose耳机上看到的问题。这些耳机听起来仍然不错，但它们没有达到可能和应该达到的水平。

通常，我会给声音轮廓有小问题的入耳式耳机稍微高一点的评分，因为它们仍然相当可用，听起来也不错。但是，这些耳机比平均水平贵得多，而我听过更便宜的耳机有更平衡的声音。索尼生产了许多套入耳式耳机和头戴式耳机，但这些并不是他们最好的产品之一。

原文: I love how well these fit in my ear even for prolonged use. These are my first Beats product which I bought solely on Apple’s name behind it. The ergonomics are sublime, and wish I could say the same for the sound quality. I christened it’s first use by playing a song by The Smiths. Johnny Marrs’ bass lines were way overpowering (more than it usually is), so I struggled a bit with his drowning out Morrisey’s lyrics. I did find that sweet spot with personal favorites Like Joan Armatrading’s “Love and Affection”, and “Smoking Gun” by Robert Cray Band. So perhaps it’s more the track quality, or genre such as EDM, House, or other music with heavy-handed bass lines. I like these ear buds, but not love them….especially not at the price tag.
中文翻译: 我喜欢它们即使长时间佩戴也能很好地贴合耳朵。这是我第一个Beats产品，完全是冲着苹果的品牌买的。人体工学设计非常出色，但音质方面我就不能这么说了。我第一次使用时播放了The Smiths的一首歌。Johnny Marr的贝斯线过于强势（比平时更甚），所以我有点难以听清Morrissey的歌词被盖住了。后来我在个人喜欢的歌曲中找到了平衡点，比如Joan Armatrading的《Love and Affection》和Robert Cray Band的《Smoking Gun》。所以也许更多是曲目质量的问题，或者是EDM、House等重低音音乐类型的问题。我喜欢这些耳塞，但不算热爱……尤其是考虑到价格。

原文: These are fairly comfortable, but there is very little tolerance in finding the 'sweet spot' so that you can hear the audio. If the speaker moves only a few millimeters, then the audio is muffled and difficult to hear, if you can hear it at all.  I spend more time trying to nudge the speaker into the right position than anything.  The headband also has a tendency to slip down over my eyes, perhaps because I have a very large head. All in all, these are a neat concept, but just too finicky for realistic use.
中文翻译: 这些还算舒适，但在找到能听到音频的‘最佳位置’方面容错率非常低。如果扬声器只移动几毫米，音频就会变得闷糊且难以听清，甚至可能完全听不到。我花在把扬声器挪到正确位置上的时间比什么都多。头带也容易滑下来遮住我的眼睛，也许是因为我的头非常大。总的来说，这是个很巧妙的构思，但实际使用中太挑剔了。

原文: Does not last near as long as the original and when the charger is connected to it, it causes a buzzing sound when recording with Garageband. Overall, not a great product but decent compared to what Apple charges.
中文翻译: 它的续航远不如原装产品，而且当充电器连接到它时，用Garageband录音会产生嗡嗡声。总体而言，不是很好的产品，但相比苹果的收费还算可以。

原文:
Nice speaker, connects easily and sounds really good. It is very small as one would expect of a) a portable, water-resistant Bluetooth speaker b) any speaker at this price point; but it is more than adequate to listen to while cooking, take to the beach etc and the sound is quite good. It is a Sony which has a lot to do with why it was one of the number I considered before purchasing. I have several Sony electronics and they have proven to be reliable and of good quality. All things being equal(ish) I went with the brand I know. It has decent reviews and was very reasonably priced.

It has proven to be a good little speaker. The sound is very good and no distortion even taken as loud as it will go. I may be 63, but the tunes I have and play are Five Finger Death Punch, Halestorm, Royal Blood, Breaking Benjamin and so forth, so it gets a workout - no Bach or easy-listening milquetoast music. I am pleased so far.

My only con, and it isn’t really a dealbreaker for me, though it is VERY disappointing, is the volume level. It tops out before I wish it would. It can be played loud, but not as loud as I want/wish. I suppose it has to do with size and governing volume so as not to blow the speaker, but I have a sneaking suspicion it is like the volume control on my 2015 RAV4. It maxes out in my car, at the level Big Brother deems is the top level that is for our own good. You know, to save us from ourselves, keep us from blowing an eardrum (as if). Like headphones and earbuds do. We are too stupid to be left to run wild with that volume control!!

Besides the infuriating limit to volume level, overall I am really liking it. I haven’t had it a long time, so if anything changes I will update. So far, it is a good buy.
中文翻译:
不错的音箱，连接方便，音质听起来真的很好。它非常小，正如人们对a）便携、防水的蓝牙音箱 b）这个价位的任何音箱所预期的那样；但它足以在做饭、去海滩等时候听，而且音质相当好。它是索尼的，这很大程度上解释了为什么它是我购买前考虑的众多型号之一。我有几件索尼电子产品，它们被证明可靠且质量好。在所有条件大致相同的情况下，我选择了我熟悉的品牌。它评价不错，而且价格非常合理。

它被证明是一个不错的小音箱。音质非常好，即使开到最大音量也没有失真。我可能63岁了，但我拥有和播放的曲子是Five Finger Death Punch、Halestorm、Royal Blood、Breaking Benjamin等等，所以它得到了锻炼——不是巴赫或轻松聆听的软绵绵音乐。到目前为止我很满意。

我唯一的缺点，对我来说并不是真正的破坏因素，尽管它非常令人失望，是音量水平。它在我希望它达到之前就达到上限了。它可以播放得很大声，但没有我想要的/希望的那么大声。我想这与尺寸和控制音量以免损坏音箱有关，但我有一种暗中的怀疑，它就像我2015年RAV4上的音量控制。它在我的车里达到最大，达到老大哥认为对我们自己有利的最高水平。你知道，为了拯救我们自己，防止我们震破耳膜（好像会似的）。就像耳机和耳塞那样。我们太愚蠢了，不能放任我们随意使用那个音量控制！！

除了令人恼火的音量限制，总体而言我真的很喜欢它。我还没有拥有它很长时间，所以如果有任何变化我会更新。到目前为止，它是一笔好买卖。

原文:
Theses headphones are affordable, wireless headphones that seem good for any traveler. The 20 hour battery life is very impressive, plus it can be recharged with a microUSB charger.

The ANC doesn't entirely cover up a screaming 2 year old, but it does a decent enough job. These aren't $200+ Bose headphones actually.

Sounds and music were good and crisp. Bass was lacking a bit. Bass heads won't like these cans.

They're very comfortable. My longest wearing session was 2-1/2 hours. No sweating, no ear numbness. Headphones can sound like heaven, but if they ain't comfortable all is lost. My wife fell asleep with these on for almost 5 hours. NO complaints from her either.

For the money these are some excellent headphones. My one hour flight to Miami was absolute heaven with the ANC on.
中文翻译:
这些耳机是价格实惠的无线耳机，似乎适合任何旅行者。20小时的电池续航非常令人印象深刻，而且可以用microUSB充电器充电。

主动降噪不能完全掩盖一个尖叫的2岁小孩，但效果还算不错。这些可不是200多美元的Bose耳机。

声音和音乐很好，很清晰。低音有点不足。低音爱好者不会喜欢这些耳机。

它们非常舒适。我最长佩戴时间是2个半小时。没有出汗，耳朵没有麻木。耳机听起来可能像天堂，但如果它们不舒适，一切都完了。我妻子戴着它们睡了将近5个小时。她也没有任何抱怨。

就价格而言，这些是极好的耳机。我飞往迈阿密的一小时航班，打开主动降噪，绝对是天堂。

原文: Bass not good & Not loud compared to Jabra Soul mate.  Returned.
中文翻译: 低音不好，而且和 Jabra Soul mate 相比不够响。已退货。

原文: I specifically did NOT want noise-canceling headphones. I also did not want ones with the rubber in them. Both things aggravate my tinnitus. These are perfect. They fit in my ears easily, and pair immediately with my macbook every time I use them. Sound and audio is great for zoom meetings, and music sounds fantastic, too. I could not ask for better.
中文翻译: 我特意不想要降噪耳机。我也不想要带橡胶的。这两样都会加重我的耳鸣。这些很完美。它们很容易戴入我的耳朵，而且每次使用时都能立即与我的MacBook配对。声音和音频对于Zoom会议来说很棒，音乐听起来也很棒。我不能要求更好的了。

原文: These headphones are fantastic.  The sound quality is good but not amazing, but for the price of the headphones the sound quality is good.  I was really impressed with the battery life, at a full charge the battery lasts forever.  I'm sure you will not be disappointed with this purchase.
中文翻译: 这些耳机太棒了。音质不错，但不算惊艳，不过就这个耳机的价格而言，音质算好的。电池续航让我印象深刻，充满电后电池能用很久。我相信你不会对这次购买失望。

原文:
These are OK, but not as good as the ones that came with my iPhone. Also, they say they work with an iPhone, but they don’t work with my iPhone 7 that has a lightning adapter and not one of these 3.5 mm ones.

音质不如我iPhone附带的耳机那么明亮。事实上，它们没有提供iPhone耳塞那样的音量。我给它们三星，因为它们非常舒适。

原文:
While not as HiFi sounding as some other cheap phones, I like these enough that I bought a 2nd set. The 2nd set had more bass than the first set, almost too much, but not so much that I didn't like them. If I lost them I would replace them.

These might not be for everyone. They have a strong but tight bass. Not boomy or tubby but the bass is there. I really like these phones for rock music and because they have plenty of bass I don't have to turn them up looking for bass.

5 stars for value
4 stars because there are other phones with a cleaner sound (try the Koss KSC75 for a more hifi sound for cheap)

这些可能不适合所有人。它们有强劲但紧凑的低音。不轰头也不浑浊，但低音就在那里。我真的很喜欢这些耳机听摇滚乐，而且因为它们有足够的低音，我不必为了寻找低音而调大音量。

性价比5星

原文:
It synced and played music perfectly, but phone reception was terrible. The other people could hear me fine, but the sound i received was intermittent, distorted, and had a brrrrrrr ringing echo to every sound, even the ringing when i made a call.
I could not make out what the other people were saying at all.

I looked in trouble shooting, and it says the unit can get "interference from a wireless LAN, other 2.4 GHz wireless device, or microwave oven." Shocking! Where someone can go these days where none of these other devices are operating? i went 30 feet outside my house and it was just as bad.

Or maybe the one i got is just a lemon. I don't know.

I called SONY and they said to try the reset, but i'd already done that, so they offered to let me send it to them so a techie could look at it. I'm returning it in stead.
中文翻译:
它同步并播放音乐完美，但手机接收信号很糟糕。其他人能听清我说话，但我收到的声音是断断续续的、失真的，而且每个声音都有一种嗡嗡的铃声回声，甚至我打电话时的铃声也是如此。
我完全听不清对方在说什么。

我查看了故障排除，上面说该设备可能会受到“无线局域网、其他2.4 GHz无线设备或微波炉的干扰”。令人震惊！现在哪里能找到这些设备都不运行的地方？我走到房子外面30英尺处，情况还是一样糟糕。

或者也许我拿到的这个只是个次品。我不知道。

我打电话给索尼，他们说试试重置，但我已经做过了，所以他们提出让我寄给他们让技术人员看看。我还是决定退货。

中文翻译: 这是作为礼物购买的，已经寄给别人了。等我得到信息后会进行评价。

UPDATE (11/1/2014): I'm getting complaints from my partner about how deaf I am and how loud I crank up the TV, so I figured I'd better get some headphones to use with my Samsung Smart TV (which is not Bluetooth-capable, so I'll have to get a transmitter). I gave up trying to use Bluetooth such a long time ago that I didn't realize these headphones were Bluetooth! I was hunting all over the place for a pair of wireless headphones with the look and feel of these, and in the process, I rediscovered these are Bluetooth! (Heck, it's been three years since I first got these, so forgive this little old lady for not remembering.) Anyway, I realized there were (were) two problems with me using these as anything other than wired. First is that the signals (the blue or white lights, which flash or breathe depending on what you're doing) can't be seen if they are under your fingertip. So you have to make sure you don't completely cover up the light. Second, it really does depend on what kind of Bluetooth-capable device you use. To test these, I paired them with my new MacBook Pro Retina. My old Mac didn't do very well, kept dropping the sound, couldn't stay paired, etc. I got a new MacBook Pro, now running Yosemite, and I'm sitting here listening to Pandora coming all the way through about 15 feet and a thick wall and it's great! And this is the "discontinued" set that I've had all this time. They charged up in very little time, too. So if you can get 'em, get 'em.

Because of very small ears and ear canals, I cannot successfully wear the in-ear headphones, but most over-ear headphones with decent sound that I've tried have been too unwieldy and uncomfortable to wear. Not these. The ear cups feel like memory foam covered with soft, breathable leather, and they conform to your ears, making for a pleasurable listening experience. They fit snuggly without pinching, and they have little brail-like raised nubs on the left side of the headband so you can tell in the dark how to put them on. (The wired cord fits into the right-side headphone cup, which is where the rest of the controls are.)

The wired sound is fantastic. I can hear all the nuances of the music even when it is turned down quite low, which is the way I prefer to listen to music; otherwise, my ears start hurting even at moderate volume. The wireless sound is also good, unless you walk too far away from your computer. I walked from my bedroom past the bathroom and into the kitchen, and only when I got into the kitchen did the sound start breaking up.

I had a terrible time getting the bluetooth pairing to work, though. (The instructions are terrible, and one should not have to go hunting all over Philips' website for the proper PDF to download just to get the headphones up and running the first time. I gave up looking and asked on the Amazon Vine forum to see if anyone else reviewing these headphones had found the requisite information; fortunately, somebody had.) I first tried pairing them to my MacBook Pro while visiting my sister in Atlanta, in a condo sandwiched between other condos, and could not get them to work at all. I had resigned myself to using them wired, but when I got home to my rural house, I was able to get them to connect and work by first deleting the original pairing and starting over. I don't know if I was experiencing interference or not. I have always found Bluetooth to be quirky, so I don't blame the headphones for what's clearly a Bluetooth issue, but Philips would do well to explain this most maddening aspect of their product a little better in a printed product insert.

Another thing that is badly explained is the setup for both input and output. I have not had the opportunity to test the internal headset/microphone and I'm not even going to try because I'm afraid I'll screw up the output from the headphones. I'm just using my computer's internal mic for any conversations I might have.
中文翻译:
更新（2014年11月1日）：我的伴侣抱怨我耳背，电视音量开得太大，所以我想最好买副耳机配我的三星智能电视用（电视不支持蓝牙，所以还得买个发射器）。我很久以前就放弃用蓝牙了，以至于没意识到这副耳机是蓝牙的！我到处找一副外观和手感都像这样的无线耳机，结果发现这本来就是蓝牙的！（哎呀，我第一次买这副耳机已经是三年前了，请原谅我这小老太太记性不好。）总之，我意识到把它当有线以外的用途有两个问题。首先，信号灯（蓝色或白色的灯，根据你在做什么会闪烁或呼吸）如果被指尖挡住就看不见了。所以你得确保别把灯完全遮住。其次，这真的取决于你用什么样的蓝牙设备。为了测试，我把它们和我的新MacBook Pro Retina配对。我的旧Mac表现很差，声音老是断，配对也保持不住等等。我买了新的MacBook Pro，现在运行Yosemite，我坐在这里听Pandora，隔着大约15英尺和一堵厚墙，效果棒极了！而且这还是我用了这么久的“已停产”版本。充电也很快。所以如果你能买到，就买吧。

因为耳朵和耳道很小，我戴不了入耳式耳机，但大多数音质不错的头戴式耳机我试过的都太笨重、戴着不舒服。这副不一样。耳罩感觉像记忆海绵外面包着柔软透气的皮革，贴合耳朵，听音乐很享受。它们贴合紧密但不夹耳朵，头带左侧有类似盲文的小凸起，这样你在黑暗中也能知道怎么戴。（有线插在右侧耳罩，其他控件也在那边。）

有线音质非常棒。即使音量调得很低，我也能听到音乐的所有细节，这是我喜欢的听歌方式；否则，即使中等音量我的耳朵也会开始疼。无线音质也不错，除非你离电脑太远。我从卧室走过浴室到厨房，只有进厨房时声音才开始断。

原文:
I don’t consider myself an audiophile. Most of the time I can’t hear a difference between headphones. But when I put on these headphones from Targeal, I immediately noticed the lack of sound quality.

Audio played through these headphones sounds like it’s coming from far away. And whenever music or audio is playing, there’s a stuttering sound in the background. The stuttering sound pauses a few seconds after I pause the audio, but starts right back up when I hit play again. The background noise is incredibly annoying to my ears.

I had my mom try the headphones too; she’s even less of an audiophile than I am. She immediately picked up on the distant sound and the background noise, without me mentioning them to her.

The headphones have a plastic build feeling, and though they are lightweight, they aren’t super comfortable. The ear cushions on these are small, making them closer to on ear headphones rather than over ear. TARGEAL is emblazoned in silver print on both sides.

The headphones have physical buttons which is a plus: power/pairing, volume up, and volume down. They play an audio cue when powering on, connecting, and powering off. The cue is *loud* no matter what volume I set the headphones at. Fortunately pairing is easy; the instruction manual has the smallest text size I’ve ever seen in a manual.

The headphones charge via micro USB. A cable is included and so is an audio cable if you want to use the headphones in wired mode.
中文翻译:
我不认为自己是发烧友。大多数时候我听不出耳机之间的区别。但当我戴上Targeal的这款耳机时，我立刻注意到了音质的缺失。

通过这些耳机播放的音频听起来像是从很远的地方传来的。而且每当音乐或音频播放时，背景中都有一种断断续续的声音。这种断断续续的声音在我暂停音频几秒后停止，但当我再次按下播放时又立刻出现。背景噪音对我的耳朵来说非常烦人。

我也让我妈妈试了这款耳机；她比我更不是发烧友。她立刻注意到了遥远的声音和背景噪音，而我并没有向她提及这些。

耳机有塑料感，虽然轻，但不是很舒适。耳垫很小，更像是贴耳式耳机而不是包耳式。两侧都有银色印刷的TARGEAL字样。

耳机有物理按钮，这是一个优点：电源/配对、音量加、音量减。它们在开机、连接和关机时会播放音频提示音。无论我把耳机音量调到多少，提示音都*很响*。幸运的是配对很容易；说明书上的文字是我见过的最小的。

耳机通过micro USB充电。附带了一根线，还有一根音频线，如果你想用有线模式使用耳机的话。

The sound quality is awesome, and they actually stay in my ears!! I mean I can get up and walk around without them falling out. 原文: After having to use broken headphones for so long, these were really a godsend. This headphones make my music sound so much better. There are the literally the best headphones I've ever had the pleasure of using. The sound is exceptionally clear. And the staging is really excellent, I can really hear the spacing in the room of the recording. And the bass makes the sound feel nice and big. It's also nice and powerful, not too thumpy, or distorted, just makes the sound fat and rich. I also like how they differentiate the right and left earbuds with a red ring around the right ear, it gives a fast visual for which earbud goes where. The L-shaped connector makes it to keep your music player in your pocket without the connector sticking out. The only thing I have to say is that the cord is kinda a sticky plastic/rubber feel, which could potentially be a  lint magnet, but I think that make sit more flexible to resist the cord sheath form snapping. I am really pleased with these headphones, they are a great price for really good quality.
中文翻译: 在不得不使用破损耳机这么久之后，这些真的是天赐之物。这款耳机让我的音乐听起来好多了。它们简直是我有幸使用过的最好的耳机。声音异常清晰。而且声场非常出色，我真的能听到录音空间中的间隔。低音让声音感觉饱满而宏大。它也很强劲，不会过于沉闷或失真，只是让声音变得丰满而丰富。我还喜欢它们用右耳上的红色环来区分左右耳塞，这提供了一个快速的视觉提示，知道哪个耳塞戴哪边。L型连接器使得你可以把音乐播放器放在口袋里而不会让连接器突出来。我唯一要说的是，线材有点粘性的塑料/橡胶感，可能会成为 lint 磁铁，但我认为这使它更灵活，以防止线材护套断裂。我对这些耳机真的很满意，它们以非常实惠的价格提供了非常好的质量。

But how could that be? Or perhaps the antenna itself has a weak internal connection that fails to carry the most strong signal? 中文翻译: 在本地调频古典电台的响亮段落中可以听到削波（又称爆裂声）。就好像信号强度被弄得过强了——但这怎么可能呢？而随索尼盒子附带的简单单线天线（在我们最近搬家后才刚找到）却工作正常。会不会是 Bingfu 天线过驱动了 75 欧姆的 FM 天线输入？但这怎么可能呢？或者天线本身内部连接薄弱，无法承载最强的信号？FM 是频率调制，不是幅度调制，所以幅度保持不变，对吧？那为什么会有削波？好了，你明白意思了。这个 Bingfu 被扔进杂物箱，留作……什么呢。

原文:
I just got this headband, and because I've got a small head, it's too loose. I have to hold my hands over the speakers to get really rich sound...but it IS really rich. Even without doing this, it's a good sound. I've got the back of the band tacked up with a bobby pin right now, but I'll probably wind up sewing it for a more permanent fit. I've got this band paired to my Echo, and I was able to tell Alexa to unpair; I couldn't get it to pair after I unpaired, so it may be a permanent thing. I'll have to play with it.

I bought this so I could listen to music while I'm on my treadmill in the living room, away from my Alexa Echo. And it will work great for that. But what I really, really love about this headband is that I can wear it while I'm out gardening, and it will not only be a sweat band, it doesn't cut out in any part of the garden (I've got a little less than half an acre) except when I get to the farthest corner from the bedroom in which I have my Echo. That corner has perennials I don't have to deal with regularly, so that's fine with me, although I could probably get more coverage if I stuck an Alexa something in the kitchen. So this is a fantastic thing that I wasn't expecting.
中文翻译:
我刚拿到这个发带，因为我的头比较小，它太松了。我得用手捂住扬声器才能获得真正丰富的声音……但它确实非常丰富。即使不这样做，音质也很好。我现在用发夹把发带后面固定住了，但可能最终会缝一下，让它更合身。我把这个发带和我的Echo配对了，我能够告诉Alexa取消配对；取消配对后我无法重新配对，所以这可能是个永久性的问题。我得再试试。

我买这个是为了在客厅的跑步机上听音乐，远离我的Alexa Echo。它会非常适合这个用途。但我真正非常喜欢这个发带的地方是，我可以在外出园艺时戴着它，它不仅是吸汗带，而且在花园的任何地方都不会断连（我的花园不到半英亩），除了当我走到离我放Echo的卧室最远的角落时。那个角落有多年生植物，我不需要经常打理，所以对我来说没问题，尽管如果我在厨房放个Alexa设备，可能覆盖范围会更大。所以这是一个我没想到的绝妙之处。

原文: Bulky but overall, has a good battery life. The sound could be much better, but it gets the task done til a better speaker can be purchased! If you are looking for a great clearness in sound, "This Speaker is Not It"!

原文: Avoid. Within the first hour of use the left earbud (the slave) had been cutting out. The audio even froze up making this grinding noise as it repeated the last few milliseconds of playback over and over and over. I thought it was my phone/app so I turned off Bluetooth so the buds would disconnect. The weird noise kept going until I put them in the case and took them out again. Oh yeah, and the case looks bulky and awkward in my pocket. Very little noise isolation—they provide two sizes of ear tips but neither provided a good seal. I had my hopes up, but connectivity glitches like I mentioned are inexcusable for the price point.
